objective: Implement deterministic completeness and duplicate checks over schema-validated canonical historical records without inferring sequence, staleness or provider-divergence semantics.
scope: Require explicit completeness expectations rather than infer missing data from sequence gaps
Require a schema-validation evidence digest from P07-A at the batch boundary
Detect missing expected record identities deterministically
Report unexpected record identities without treating them as missing-data failures
Detect exact logical duplicates with distinct record IDs
Detect conflicting logical duplicates with distinct record IDs
Return deterministic duplicate findings and report fingerprints
Fail closed on missing expected data or any duplicate finding
Reconcile active task/lock state in GitHub and Linear
out_of_scope: Sequence gap inference, staleness or outlier checks (P07-C)
tests: Unexpected records are reported deterministically without being confused with missing records
Repeated identical record ID is exact duplicate and fails closed
Reused record ID with different content is conflicting duplicate and fails closed
Distinct record IDs with same logical event and same content are exact logical duplicates
Distinct record IDs with same logical event and different content are conflicting logical duplicates
Non-contiguous sequence IDs alone do not imply incompleteness
Report ordering and fingerprint are deterministic
P07-B evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P07-B module, policy, tests, evidence/CI wiring and state reconciliation. P07-A remains canonical and no trading state changes.
definition_of_done: Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
